meta.title: PQueue task lifecycle: add() to settlement

views.label: Admission path
views.note: Follow newly added work from the priority queue through pause, concurrency, and interval admission.

views.label: Settlement and restart
views.note: See task settlement release capacity and immediately ask the controller to start more waiting work.

views.label: Abort and timeout
views.note: Queued abort removes and rejects; running abort races the task, while timeout begins only after execution starts.

components.sublabel: not paused; concurrency and interval allow

components.label: Caller task execution

connections.label: try to start more queued work
abort while waiting: remove and reject
abort while running: task must handle signal
timeout starts after dequeue; rejects on expiry

cards.title: Queued and active work differ
items: A queued abort removes the runnable task and rejects the add() promise
A running abort is raced into the promise; the task itself must observe the signal

cards.title: Admission and recovery
items: Starts require the queue to be unpaused and both concurrency and interval capacity to allow another task
Every settlement schedules next() in a microtask, releasing capacity before starting more queued work

cards.title: Execution timeout
items: Timeout wraps the operation only after it is dequeued and begins execution
Timeout rejects the add() promise; it does not describe cancellation of the underlying operation
